headline: Possible action on school policies for graduation, independent study, and advanced courses, plus admission at age 5.
summary: A closed session will cover a written legal memo on six instruction policies and three admission and attendance policies. Afterward, the group will consider recommending action on seven policies to the school board.

Closed session: attorney legal memo on three admission and attendance policies

ANNOUNCEMENT OF POLICY COMMITTEE ZOOM MEETING AND AGENDA 
TUESDAY, NOVEMBER 17, 2026 
 
Public Session: 5:00 PM 
Location- Zoom 
 
To join the meeting virtually, please click the link below to join the webinar: 
https://hamden.zoom.us/j/81309378895?pwd=xCqUvaTsoqLFO97GzrPlYMOUBt7sX1.1  
Passcode:403775 
 
Telephone: +1 646 931 3860, +1 301 715 8592, +1 305 224 1968, +1 309 205 3325, +1 312 626 6799  
Webinar ID: 813 0937 8895 
Passcode: 403775 
 
Note: Any member of the public may request, in writing, a physical location and “any electronic 
equipment necessary” to attend the meeting in real-time. Said request shall be made to 
tdonnarummo@hamden.org not less than twenty-four (24) hours prior to the meeting. 
 
For those who wish to make Public Comments: Time will be allotted for public comments at the 
beginning of the meeting. We ask that public comments be limited to no more than 1 minute in length. 
You may also submit your comment in writing. Public comments should be sent to 
PublicInput@hamden.org, with the message's subject stating the meeting's name and date (for example, 
“May 12 Operations Committee Meeting”). Public comments will be accepted up to 1pm the day of the 
meeting. Please note the following: 
• The name and Hamden address of the person submitting public comment must be included in 
the message. 
• Remarks should be brief and concise, with a maximum length of three minutes (about 450 
characters). 
• Comments should start with a 2-3 sentence summary. The summary will be read instead of the 
entire message if there is a large number of comments and reading each of them in their entirety 
would extend beyond the time allotted for public comment. 
 
1. Call to order and roll call 
 
2. Additions to the agenda 
 
3. Public Comment on agenda items 
 
4. Executive Session 
a. Discussion of attorney-client privileged written memorandum (legal advice regarding 
instruction, admission, and attendance-related policies) for the following policies: 
INSTRUCTION--RELATED POLICIES 
• Policy 6146 (Graduation Requirements) 
• Policy 6141.4 and Regulation 6141.4 (Independent Study) 
• Policy 6141.51 (Advanced Courses or Programs, Eligibility Criteria for Enrollment) 
• Policy 6141.52 (Challenging Curriculum – Criteria for Identification of Eligible Grade 8, 9 
Students) 
• Policy 6141.5 (Advanced College Placement) 
• Policy 6172.6 (External and Online Credit Options)
ADMISSION AND ATTENDANCE-RELATED POLICIES   
• Policy 5111: Admission to the Public Schools At or Before Age 5 
• Policy and Regulation 5113:  Attendance – Unexcused Absences 
• Policy and Regulation 6172.3: Home Schooling Statutory Authority  
 
 
5. Information and Possible Action Items 
a. Approval to recommend to the BOE various actions regarding the following policies: 
• Policy 6146 (Graduation Requirements) 
• Policy 6141.4 (Independent Study) 
• Policy 6141.51 (Advanced Courses or Programs, Eligibility Criteria for Enrollment) 
• Policy 6141.52 (Challenging Curriculum – Criteria for Identification of Eligible Grade 8, 9 
Students) 
• Policy 6141.5 (Advanced College Placement) 
• Policy 6172.6 (External and Online Credit Options) 
• Policy 5111: Admission to the Public Schools At or Before Age 5 
 
6. Adjourn
